title: a receiver that escaped from a failed constructor stays unfinished
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: The constructor failed after its receiver escaped into an Atomic; the escaped value never completes construction, and only execution can see it.

provenance.origin: authored for #271 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.4: a failed constructor does not return an object; runtime rejects every action dispatch on a receiver whose construction is pending.
